items.summary: Pittsburgh, PA, Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- A leak in a slate roof does not automatically mean the entire roof has failed. Water can enter through damaged or slipped slate, worn flashing, valleys, chimney details, penetrations, or another vulnerable part of the roof assembly. That is why finding the source of a slate roof leak matters before deciding how to repair it. Where water appears inside a home may not be directly below where it entered the roof. A proper evaluation should consider both the slate and the components that direct water around roof transitions.
